# pve_storage_scan_nfs (Data Source)

NFS exports discovered by scanning from a node (server optionally constrained).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_storage_scan_nfs" "example" {
node = "pve1"
server = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `server` (String) The server address (name or IP).

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/scan/nfs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `scan_types` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/scan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan_types))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `options` (String) NFS export options.
- `path` (String) The exported path.


<a id="nestedatt--scan_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scan_types`

Read-Only:

- `method` (String)
